summary: Broadened the Turtle ingestion from (type=vault, >=$1M, allowlisted curators only) to (all types, >=$100K, non-Morpho, non-testnet) with source-derived curator identity: auto-create a clean tc:<slug> curator from the Turtle-provided curator name, EXCEPT a denylist of protocols/infra. Verified ZERO Morpho<->Turtle double-counting (extractProtocol excludes morpho-described opps; 82 name-overlap opps all excluded).

policy.filter: tvl>=100000 AND protocol!=morpho AND chain not in {sepolia,pharos,goerli,holesky,fuji,mumbai}; all opportunity types (vault/lending/staking)
policy.curator_resolution: 1) match existing DB curator by name/alias; 2) allowlisted tc: curator; 3) auto-create tc:<slug> from Turtle curator name unless denylisted; else skip (not stored)
policy.midas_decision: Midas KEPT as a curator (RWA manager), not denylisted — per Austin
policy.dedup: one Turtle opportunity = one vault, keyed on address `turtle-<opp.id>`. Removed the curator+asset+chain+protocol combo-dedup (it wrongly collapsed distinct vaults and desynced turtleId<->address).

code_changes: curator-matcher.ts: step-3 auto-create tc:<slug> from opp.curator.name (non-denylisted); slugifyCurator()
collect-turtle-data.ts: filter broaden (all types, $100K, testnet exclusion); skip-if-unresolved; upsert keyed on address (removed combo-dedup); vaultFields.active=true
run-turtle.ts: new CLI runner (npm run collect:turtle)
reversal: To revert: git revert the broaden commit; then DELETE FROM Curator WHERE address LIKE 'tc:%' AND address NOT IN (the 6 baseline tc: addresses) after nulling/reassigning their vaults; re-run the old collector. Turtle vaults are fully reconstructable from the public API, so the safest reset is delete-all-turtle-vaults + re-run.
